notes.title: A Tapestry of Old and New Titles! RPG Maker Festival 2025 Begins! Celebrate Over
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/b4645591bfd53a650090cbdd251797c26a158406.jpg
About RPG Maker Festival 2025
Maker Day (Tsukuru no Hi, February 15th) is the day for recognizing and spreading the joy of making games! 
To celebrate this day, we are holding the online event 'RPG Maker Festival' again this year!

The "RPG Maker Festival" is a grand event with the theme of "Creators and players, everyone is the star!"
There'll be new releases and lots of discounts for RPG Maker products, DLCs, and a large number of games created with RPG Maker.
This year, the number of participating titles is 1074 games - a record for the event! Don't miss your chance to discover new masterpieces and make some great purchases.

Additionally 2025 represents the 5th anniversary for RPG Maker MZ, the 10th anniversary for RPG Maker MV, and the 25th anniversary for RPG Maker 2000! To celebrate these anniversaries, RPG Maker Festival 2025  is spread out over 2 weeks due to all we have planned! We hope you will be with us for the whole journey!


■RPG Maker Festival 2025 Dates
Phase 1: February 4th, 2025  until February 11th 2025. 
Phase 2: February 11th 2025 until February 18th 2025

■Phase 1 Event URL
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RPGMakerFestival2025


Part One Events
RPG Maker VX Ace Available For Free
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/56da34f7c8f2288ed6423a5c4b7436d17d44d9e2.png
It’s our pleasure to announce that for a limited time, RPG MakerVX Ace, with global sales exceeding 500,000 copies,  will be available for free download!
It set the roadmap for the actors, items, database and other functions that carry through to RPG Maker MZ today! Even today many fans love the feel provided by RPG Maker VX Ace! We hope many people will give it a try during this limited opportunity!

■ Free Download Period
February 4th until February 11th, 2025
･URL： https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RPGMakerFestival2025


Big Sales! RPG Maker MZ 55％ Off, RPG Maker MV 93％ Off
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/ef51407d44f485052ef03984944cffa1a4a224d8.png
RPG Maker MZ is discounted 55％ on Steam to celebrate it’s 5th anniversary! RPG Maker MV, celebrating it’s 10th anniversary,  will be available at the amazing value of 93％ off on Steam!
Additionally, a major update is coming very soon for RPG Maker MZ, making it even easier to use!
And for those who are already owners of some RPG Maker titles, there’s special celebration available with even more discounts!

■ Steam Discount Period
February 4th until February 11th, 2025
・RPG Maker MZ Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096900/RPGMZ/?utm_source=PR&utm_campaign=referral&utm_medium=RPGMakerFestival2025_SteamNews_EN
・RPG Maker MV Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/363890/RPGMV/?utm_source=PR&utm_campaign=referral&utm_medium=RPGMakerFestival2025_SteamNews_EN


RPG Maker Game Celebrations

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/0b30ddf0f8f8a93e0f89bd6bded9a8b443df3193.png
RPG Maker is more than just the engine; it’s also all the games that the community has made over the many years! To celebrate these creations, event pages have been created on both Steam and DLsite!
More than 1000 games are participating!
You’ll be able to find indie experiences from all over the world, many of which will also be on sale as a part of the RPG Maker Festival experience!

・Steam Event Page： https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RPGMakerFestival2025
・Introduction Video for Participating Titles :  https://youtu.be/XU2cEwwKbyU


ACTION GAME MAKER: Release Date Announcement & New Trailer on 2025/6/16!
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/863f164cbc880c65b9e2e3a2c40ee218a83c396f.png
The latest entry in the Maker franchise, ACTION GAME MAKER will announce it’s release date on February 17th, 2025!　And that’s not all: a brand new trailer will be released showing never before seen footage!
・ACTION GAME MAKER URL：https://youtu.be/JSjN67Bc_jo

Designed to allow anyone to make 2D action games without programming and built on top of Godot Engine, ACTION GAME MAKER represents a new step forward for the Maker franchise.
And with plenty of included assets, you’ll be able to get started on your game making journey!
Please visit the Steam page and wishlist it now!

・ACTION GAME MAKER Steam page：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2987180/ACTION_GAME_MAKER/?utm_source=PR&utm_campaign=referral&utm_medium=RPGMakerFestival2025_SteamNews_EN


RPG Maker 2000 DLC Reborn
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/4833f34677f6988078129e17a786e29b381ea8b3.png
It’s been an amazing 25 years since RPG Maker 2000 first released! To celebrate, we’re bringing back some content that was released with the RPG Maker 2000 Handbook specifically for RPG Maker MZ!
Tile sets and characters, animations, sound effects and voice lines and so much more are included! And all remastered for use with RPG Maker MZ! In addition, the original assets in their RPG Maker 2000/2003 compatible format are included as well!
Whether you’re a collector who never had the opportunity to get the Handbook or you just like the look of these assets, this is an amazing opportunity!

・RPG Maker 2000 Handbook Assets Steam Page：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478100/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Maker_2000_Handbook_Assets/?utm_source=PR&utm_campaign=referral&utm_medium=RPGMakerFestival2025_SteamNews_EN


Phase Two Events
During phase two of RPG Maker Festival 2025, the discounts and content sharing will continue! We’re not prepared to release that information, so we hope you will remain excited until it is unveiled at the start of phase two!

notes.title: Tag to Win DLC: The Return! (CONCLUDED)
notes.content:
Tag to Win It! DLC Giveaway Returns!

As some of you may know, Steam has recently implemented a Steam Tagging Beta. Users who opt into this beta can tag games, programs, DLC, etc. with customized categories!

So how do you win things, as the headline suggests? It's simple! Follow the Tagging Guide below for RPG Maker products and we will randomly select two winners on Wednesday every week! Each winner will receive a Steam key for one RPG Maker DLC of their choice!

The first winner will be selected from the pool of entries from the previous week. The second winner will be a cumulative selection, so if you submit an tagging entry tomorrow, you may still end up winning three weeks from now!

For each RPG Maker product you tag (with screenshot proof), you'll receive an entry into the drawing. For example: if you tag VX Ace and three DLC packs, you'll be entered into the drawing four times. For the sake of organization, please keep all of your screenshots contained to one post: you can edit previous posts to add more content.

So what are you waiting for? Get taggin' for a chance to win DLC!


Tagging Guide

Here's how you can access the tagging features and enter this giveaway!

Step 1
First, you'll need to opt into Steam Beta. Here is a guide on how to do this. (Select "Steam Beta Update" from the beta drop-down menu.)

We also recommend reading the Steam Tag Introduction here.

Step 2
After opting into Steam Beta Update, you'll be prompted to restart Steam. This may take a minute or two.

Step 3
After restarting, you can now access the Tagging feature! To tag our products and DLC, you'll need to go to the Store Page of that product. You can add tags on the right-hand side of the screen, as shown in this screenshot:

Click to view image.

Step 4
Take a screenshot of the tags you are using for either RPG Maker XP, VX Ace, or the DLC, like so:

Click to view image.

(Please note that in the screenshot above, you can clearly see which tags are being created, as well as which product is being tagged. We'll need to see both of these things in your screenshot for you to be eligible for the giveaway.)'


Rules

1. To qualify for this giveaway, you must follow the tagging guide mentioned above: in the screenshot, we need to see both the product being tagged as well as all the tags you are applying.
2. Only responses in this topic (as well as anything you posted in the original topic) will count towards the giveaway.
3. You can tag as many products as you want. You will receive one entry into the giveaway for each RPG Maker program or DLC that you tag. However, if you already tagged items in the original giveaway, you can add new tags for this giveaway.
4. Posting inappropriate tags is grounds for disqualification: Steam will be promptly removing such tags as well.
5. For uploading screenshots, we recommend Imgur or a similar program; you can post the hyperlinks in your response here. (Imgur may be banned in your country, in which case you'll want to use another image sharing website.)
6. The drawings will be held just after Midnight UTC on Wednesdays. We will be holding two drawings: one winner will be selected from the pool of entries from the previous week, and the other winner will be selected from the cumulative pull of entries since the start of the giveaway. Tags submitted during the February giveaway will qualify for the cumulative raffles!
7. If you have already tagged a product in a previous week, you can submit again but your tags must be new additions!
8. Contestents can win up to three times. If someone has already one thrice and is selected again, we will have to select a new winner.
9. You can tag games made with RPG Maker if you wish.

notes.title: Steam Workshop is Live!
notes.content:
A new era has begun for RPG Maker on Steam!
We are pleased to announce that RPG Maker VX Ace is finally integrated with Steam Workshop!

This groundbreaking feature makes it incredibly easy for you to find and import great free resources into your games, as well as share your creations and more! VX Ace's Steam Workshop also serves as a centralized hub for aspiring developers like yourself, allowing you to promote your game and receive honest feedback from other Steam users!

Events and sales!
This release has been a long time in the making, and we want to celebrate the occasion. First and foremost, Valve is featuring RPG Maker and most of the DLC titles in their Midweek Madness sale at 75% off!

As an added bonus, for the first week we will be holding drawings for prizes: all you have to do to enter is have something up in the Workshop! At the end of the week, we will even be picking some of our favorite uploads for even MORE winners. Don't miss out!

Here are some of the other events in the pipeline:

RPG Maker for the Not-So-Bright Screenshot Contest: Post a screenshot on Steam of a boneheaded mistake you've made, or a mistake you see made constantly, with a funny caption describing it. From writing errors to graphics mistakes, or from coding errors to clicking the wrong box, tell us about your comical RM error! Screenshots will be judged on helpfulness and humor.

DLC 2: Return of DLC Topic Giveaway: Which of our DLCs do you think needs a second visit with added resources? We will pick random participants from the conversation to win prizes!

What about content?
We've already posted approximately 30 projects from some of the biggest names in the RM community, ranging from completed games to resource packs. Be sure to check them out here!

If you want to upload your own projects to Steam Workshop, we've prepared a step-by-step guide here. You can also check out some of the frequently asked questions there as well.

We're excited for this release and we can't wait to see what everyone posts!

notes.title: RPG Maker 24th Anniversary and Contests!
notes.content:
To celebrate RPG Maker's 24th Birthday, we at RPG Maker Web Staff, The RMW Resource Staff and, RMN decided to do something special! 

For now, let's start off with a contest~
Any questions? Ask them on our blog over here! It'd be easier for us to track down there than in Steam.

ENCOUNTERS OF THE BOSS KIND CONTEST

This will be the first year that we celebrate RPG Maker Day, on February 15th, and to celebrate our 24th Birthday we will be having loads of events, giveaways, and free stuff!

And to kick it all off we are going to be hosting an awesome game making contest: Encounters of the Boss Kind! This game making contest will be a bit different though in that you will be making the shortest games possible: Just one boss fight. Here are the basic criteria for your entry:

No Scripts
No custom resources. Only use RTP or official resource packs.
The game should have the following structure: Opening Cutscene => Boss Fight => Ending Cutscene
Follow the party outline listed in the next section.


PARTY OUTLINE
Your party will consist of the following four characters:

Party Member 1: The Hero

The Hero uses a sword. He/She has some magic too. He/She is an all arounder.

1-5 Sword Skills
1 Healing Spell
1 Damage Spell
1 Wild Card Skill (Any Effect)

Party Member 2: The Healer

The Healer can use any weapon you would like. He/She focuses on healing and buff skills. His/Her skills can be set up as follows:

1 Weapon Skill
1-3 Healing Spells
1-3 Buff Spells
1 Wild Card Skill (Any Effect)

Party Member 3: The Mage

The Mage uses a staff, but not well. He/She focuses on attack spells and debuffs. His/Her skills can be set up as follows:

No Weapon Skills
1-3 Damage Spells
1-3 Debuff Spells
1-2 Wild Card Skills (Any Effect)

Party Member 4: The Wildcard

This Character is completely undecided. You can make it any kind of character you would like. His/Her skills can be set up as follows:

1-8 Wild Card Skills (Any Effect)

JUDGING CRITERIA

Your game will be judged on the following criteria:

Storyline/Writing. This will mostly be judged around the Opening and Closing cutscenes, but remember, you can use battle events to insert some lines into the boss fight as well.

Boss Fight Strategy. How much thinking does it take us to beat the boss. How much do we have to work skill combos and adapt to make it go down.

Fun. Just how much FUN do we have while playing it.

ENTERING SUBMISSIONS

YOUR ENTRY MUST BE IN BY THE END OF FEBRUARY 13th, 2014 (GMT-5)

Email your Submission to community@rpgmakerweb.com with the title “Encounters of the Boss Kind”

PRIZES

You have the chance to win the following prizes!

Grand Prize: A Steam Copy of RPG Maker VX Ace + Any one item from our Forum Store with a cost of $25 or less + 1 Free Year of Member+
Second Place: Any one item from our Forum Store with a cost of $25 or less + 3 Free Months of Member+
Third Place: Any one item from our Forum Store with a cost of $25 or less.

Now, get on making those Boss Fight Games and keep an eye out for more RPG Maker Day announcements!

The Healer can use any weapon you would like. He/She focuses on healing and buff skills. His/Her skills can be set up as follows:

1 Weapon Skill
1-3 Healing Spells
1-3 Buff Spells
1 Wild Card Skill (Any Effect)

Party Member 3: The Mage

The Mage uses a staff, but not well. He/She focuses on attack spells and debuffs. His/Her skills can be set up as follows:

No Weapon Skills
1-3 Damage Spells
1-3 Debuff Spells
1-2 Wild Card Skills (Any Effect)

Party Member 4: The Wildcard

This Character is completely undecided. You can make it any kind of character you would like. His/Her skills can be set up as follows:

1-8 Wild Card Skills (Any Effect)

JUDGING CRITERIA

Your game will be judged on the following criteria:

Storyline/Writing. This will mostly be judged around the Opening and Closing cutscenes, but remember, you can use battle events to insert some lines into the boss fight as well.

Boss Fight Strategy. How much thinking does it take us to beat the boss. How much do we have to work skill combos and adapt to make it go down.

Fun. Just how much FUN do we have while playing it.

ENTERING SUBMISSIONS

YOUR ENTRY MUST BE IN BY THE END OF FEBRUARY 13th, 2014 (GMT-5)

Email your Submission to community@rpgmakerweb.com with the title “Encounters of the Boss Kind”

PRIZES

You have the chance to win the following prizes!

Grand Prize: A Steam Copy of RPG Maker VX Ace + Any one item from our Forum Store with a cost of $25 or less + 1 Free Year of Member+
Second Place: Any one item from our Forum Store with a cost of $25 or less + 3 Free Months of Member+
Third Place: Any one item from our Forum Store with a cost of $25 or less.

Now, get on making those Boss Fight Games and keep an eye out for more RPG Maker Day announcements!

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We have some very exciting news to share to you today!
We finally released RPG Maker VXAce's Steam Cards!

 What are Steam Trading Cards? 
Steam Trading Cards are collectible cards you get by playing games on Steam. Collect a set of cards to earn items that help you customize your profile and show off your Badges. Such items include emoticons and profile backgrounds.

What's a Badge?
A badge is an icon on your profile (and tied to your account) that represents the trading card sets you've collected or your participation in an event.

How do I get them?
You can get them simply using RPG Maker VXAce in Steam! As you play, you'll occasionally receive trading card drops which will be placed in your Steam Inventory. You can only get 3 out of 5 cards. If you want to complete your collection, you will have to trade with other people or buy them in the Steam Market!
 
There is a small chance whenever you get a Trading Card from playing a game that it will have a special foil border. You'll need to collect a set of foil cards in order to craft them into a foil badge. There is no extra benefit to having foil cards or foil badges aside from their rarity.
 
For Badges, go to your Profile page, click on the "Badges" link near the top of the right column or select "Badges" from your persona name drop down in the Steam menu. From your Badges page, the "Badges in Progress" tab will show which badges are ready to be crafted. Select a ready to craft badge to view its details and click on the blue "Craft a Badge" button.
 
In addition to getting the Game Badge itself, you'll get:
a random emoticon item created for this game, that can use in chat or discussions;
a random profile background item created for this game, that can use on your Steam Community profile
a chance to get a discount coupon for a different game or DLC
100XP, which may increase your Steam Level

If your Steam Level increases, the limit on the size of your friends list will be increased by five, and potentially you'll unlock the ability to customize your profile with showcases.
 
If you gather another complete set of trading cards for the same game you can upgrade that game badge. You can craft a set for the same game at most five times. Each time you upgrade the game badge you'll get an extra 100XP, as well as upgrading the image and title of the badge.
 
There's 5 badges you can acquire through normal means, and a special badge for completing a foil set! Can you catch them all?
 
But I don't have RMVXA on Steam!
Refer to this!

Will it break my projects?
Nope. I use offline and steam RMVXA programs and never had a problem.

We hope you guys have fun collecting them!
